name: B2Apps UTM Cleaner
author: b2apps

sections.description:
B2Apps UTM Cleaner keeps your WordPress URLs clean, shareable, and free of noisy tracking parameters — with zero bloat and zero external requests.

Key Features

  • Canonical URL Cleaning: Removes tracking parameters from WordPress canonical URLs (get_canonical_url) to help prevent duplicate-URL indexing.
  • Outbound Link Cleaning: Strips tracking parameters (utm_*, fbclid, gclid, mc_cid, mc_eid, msclkid, yclid, igshid) from external links in post content while preserving legitimate query arguments and anchor fragments.
  • Redirect Cleaning: Filters wp_redirect destinations so redirects do not forward unwanted tracking tokens.
  • Copy-Clean-Link Helper & Shortcode: Provides a lightweight [cleanlink_copy] shortcode and optional history.replaceState browser address-bar cleaner.
  • Domain Allowlist & Live Tester: Exclude specific outbound domains and preview how any URL is cleaned directly under Settings -> B2Apps UTM Cleaner.

Privacy

B2Apps UTM Cleaner runs 100% locally on your WordPress site and in the visitor’s browser. It does not make external API calls, load third-party scripts, or collect any telemetry.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to /wp-content/plugins/, or install the plugin ZIP file via Plugins -> Add New -> Upload Plugin.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins menu in WordPress.
  3. Go to Settings -> B2Apps UTM Cleaner to review or customize stripped parameters and excluded domains.
  4. Optional: Add [cleanlink_copy label="Copy Clean Link"] to any post or template.
sections.faq:
Does B2Apps UTM Cleaner remove legitimate query parameters like ?page=2 or ?s=search?

No. B2Apps UTM Cleaner only removes query parameters that match your configured tracking patterns (such as utm_*, fbclid, gclid, and mc_cid). All other query arguments and #fragment anchors are preserved.

Can I keep tracking parameters for specific partner or affiliate domains?

Yes. Add those domains (one per line) to Excluded Outbound Domains under Settings -> B2Apps UTM Cleaner.

Does B2Apps UTM Cleaner phone home or send URLs to an external service?

No. Everything runs locally in PHP and vanilla JavaScript.
